result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility and visual issue regarding text contrast on the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a very light pastel green background, resulting in extremely low color contrast that makes the text barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or near-black) or darken the background color of the banner to meet WCAG contrast requirements.
